items.note: The overview calls the product 'our B2B note-taking app', and the users are framed as people on paid accounts at business customers.
The header says the audience is engineering and design leads and the status is 'Draft for kickoff'. Content is aimed at them: open questions and option tables show engineering and design impact.

The v1 scope lists creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes. Each has a requirement (R1 to R3) with acceptance criteria. One concern: the PRD also assumes v1 must work on every platform, which adds to scope, though it does flag this for confirmation.
The roles table has only Admin and Member, and the goals say v1 keeps to two roles.
Billing changes, SSO and guest access are listed under 'Out of scope'.
The success metric is stated word for word as 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days. It adds a clearly labeled assumption about when the 60 days start and invents no other metrics.

I estimate about 1,100+ words, with three tables, many headings and inline assumption notes. That likely runs past about 2 pages once formatted. The closing Assumptions section mostly repeats the inline assumptions, so the extra length is padding, not needed content.
OQ1 leaves migration of existing shared notes open ('Not decided'). It sets out options A to C with their engineering and design impact and does not choose one.
